en_title: GTA 6 Animation Director Reveals Rockstar Made 3 Animations for Each Item Interaction
cn_title: 《GTA 6》动画总监透露Rockstar为每种物品交互制作了3套动画
opus_summary: 《GTA 6》玩法动画总监Mike Jones透露，Rockstar为游戏中的每种物品交互制作了三套动画，分别对应双手空闲、仅右手空闲和仅左手空闲的情况，有时还为蹲姿重复制作。Jones也承认，开发过程中确实采取了一些捷径。

paragraphs.en: Mike Jones, the director of gameplay animation for GTA 6, revealed that the team at Rockstar created three separate animations for each item interaction in the game.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA 6》游戏玩法动画总监Mike Jones透露，Rockstar团队为游戏中的每种物品交互分别制作了三套动画。

paragraphs.en: If you’ve been playing GTA 6 at all, you’ve probably picked up on the fact that characters can now hold an item in each hand. This has made for some especially funny clips on social media, where users have wasted no time making Jason recreate the ‘six-seven’ meme while holding various objects.
paragraphs.cn: 如果你玩过《GTA 6》，可能已经注意到角色现在双手可以各拿一件物品。这在社交媒体上催生了一些特别有趣的视频片段，用户们迫不及待地让Jason手持各种物品，重现「six-seven」迷因。

paragraphs.en: This is a big change from previous Rockstar games; in titles like GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2 , players could only carry one thing at a time, though you could dual wield certain guns in GTA: San Andreas. (You could also hold longarms at your side while shooting a pistol in RDR 2 and Max Payne 3 .) Now, you can hold a sandwich in one hand and a drink in the other — or a bag and a gun, if you’re sticking up a pawn shop, for instance. This isn’t just an aesthetic feature, either, as it serves the important function of letting players take care of two tasks at once, making robberies or transporting items a bit smoother.
paragraphs.cn: 这与Rockstar以往的游戏相比是一个重大变化；在《GTA 5》和《荒野大镖客：救赎2》等作品中，玩家一次只能携带一件东西，不过在《GTA: San Andreas》中可以双持某些枪械。（在《荒野大镖客：救赎2》和《Max Payne 3》中，你也可以在使用手枪射击时，将长枪持于身侧。）现在，你可以一手拿三明治，另一手拿饮料——或者比如在抢劫当铺时，一手拿包，一手拿枪。这也不只是一个视觉上的功能，它还有一个重要作用：让玩家能够同时处理两项任务，使抢劫或搬运物品更顺畅一些。

paragraphs.en: Players have praised GTA 6 for its jaw-dropping attention to detail, and this particular tidbit wasn’t lost on them. A thread on Bluesky discussing the feature caught the attention of Mike Jones, the director of gameplay on Rockstar’s latest title, who revealed the extent of the studio’s efforts in making sure every single item interaction had a single-handed, two-handed, and hands-free animations.
paragraphs.cn: 玩家们称赞《GTA 6》对细节的关注令人瞠目结舌，而他们也没有忽略这个细节。Bluesky上一则讨论该功能的帖子引起了Rockstar最新作品游戏玩法总监Mike Jones的注意，他透露了工作室为确保每一种物品交互都有单手、双手和双手空闲时的动画而付出的努力。

paragraphs.en: “FYI, we made three versions for all item interactions; one if both hands are free, one if just your right hand is free and again for the left,” he wrote . “It was a massive pain, but once you knew every interaction could ‘cope,’ it made the game logic much easier. That was then sometimes replicated for crouch, too…”
paragraphs.cn: 他写道：「说一下，我们为所有物品交互都制作了三个版本：一个用于双手空闲时，一个用于只有右手空闲时，左手空闲时也有一个。」「这非常麻烦，但当你知道每一种交互都能应对后，游戏逻辑就简单多了。有时还要为蹲姿重复制作……」

paragraphs.en: That being said, the devs at Rockstar aren’t superheroes, and they had to cut corners somewhere during development. Jones admitted this fact in response to another comment in this thread, where a user wrote, “Honestly, the level of polish is so absurd that when I see how cheated the ‘putting gas in the car’ sequence is, I'm like, relieved. ‘Oh, okay, they're human, they bleed.’ You all did SO well.”
paragraphs.cn: 话虽如此，Rockstar的开发人员并不是超级英雄，他们在开发过程中不得不在某些地方采取省事的做法。Jones在回复帖子中的另一条评论时承认了这一点，一位用户在评论中写道：「老实说，精细程度高得太夸张了，以至于当我看到『给车加油』的动作序列有多取巧时，我反而松了口气。『哦，好吧，他们也是人，也会流血。』你们做得太好了。」

paragraphs.en: “Thanks, everyone would really appreciate your comments! And yes, shortcuts were definitely made, too,” Jones replied.
paragraphs.cn: Jones回复道：「谢谢，大家一定会很感激你的评论！没错，我们确实也采取了一些省事的做法。」

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 is a game like no other. Its world is so massive and detailed that some players are avoiding progressing the story in favor of chilling out in Key Lento and diving for treasure, fishing with Cal, and playing billiards at the Rusty Anchor. And we can’t blame them; there’s tons of stuff to do, even in Chapter 1.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA 6》是一款独一无二的游戏。它的世界如此庞大、细致，以至于一些玩家不再推进剧情，转而在Key Lento放松、潜水寻宝，与Cal一起钓鱼，以及在Rusty Anchor打台球。我们也不能怪他们；即使在第一章，也有大量事情可做。
